title: Integration Strategy Catalogue
description: Catalogue of strategic statements for the Integration architecture domain — the what and why at the highest level (outcomes, drivers, target states). Aligned to TOGAF Architecture Vision concepts with OKR-style target outcomes.

meta.description: A catalogue of strategic goals and direction for the Integration domain.
purpose: Establishes the organisation's intent for how systems connect and communicate
Prevents point-to-point proliferation by codifying a strategic direction for integration
Aligns API and event design with broader technology and business strategy
Provides the anchor for integration principles and guardrail decisions
Enables assessment of whether proposed integration patterns serve the strategy

statement.description: Strategic statement — outcome-oriented, time-bound where appropriate

driver.description: Business driver or external force motivating this strategy

target-outcome.description: Measurable success criterion (what does success look like?)
